prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 4:5 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a sunny harbour quay of pale stone with a waist-high iron railing, mooring posts of normal height and a white lighthouse behind them, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, empty of any people other than the subjects, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as them, NO dark background NO black void, TWO people standing side by side with generous spacing so every figure reads clearly and nobody's arms cross a neighbour, the camera set back so both are visible from head to toe, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, in natural sunlight, sharp focus on every figure, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

LEFT: ONE real adult Senegalese man in his mid 20s, his face exactly the same tone as his body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a youthful idol face with a small V-line jaw, bright expressive eyes and a straight nose, clean-shaven, natural idol makeup with soft brown eyeshadow and a tinted lip, deep blue-black skin with a smooth sheen, a soft amused smile, cool ash-brown hair styled in long locs gathered loosely, real living eyes, wearing matching-style earrings on both ears, each ear a large brass hoop carrying two heavy rough hammered matte metal weights on brass chains of different lengths (a gold square-sided cowbell, a silver round bell), all hanging clear of the body and none below the collarbone, and a single gold bracelet. LEFT Physique: An extraordinarily tall and large man, far beyond any real person, with a men's physique build. Enormously broad shoulders with round capped deltoids, a wide upper chest tapering sharply to a very narrow waist in a dramatic V-taper, a lean sharply defined six-pack abdomen with visible obliques, thick strong arms, and long lean athletic legs that are muscular but not bulky. His head stays in correct proportion to his broad frame. His arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
